tools.name: resolve-library-id
tools.description: Resolves a general library name into a Context7-compatible library ID. Call this before query-docs unless the user gave an ID like /vercel/next.js.

query.description: The user's question or task, used to rank results by relevance.

libraryName.description: The name of the library to search for.

tools.name: query-docs
tools.description: Retrieves up-to-date documentation and code examples for a library using a Context7-compatible library ID.

libraryId.description: Exact library ID, such as /mongodb/docs or /vercel/next.js.

query.description: The question or task to find relevant documentation for.

language.description: Programming language; ranks code examples in that language first.
